## About
Painter's Grinding was founded by Dayton Painter, who started out doing Volkswagen engine work like lifter repair and cylinder head reconditioning out of a small shop behind a friend's place. Dayton has since passed, and members of his family now run the business. The shop has grown to offer repair, engine rebuilding and machine work, all centered on air-cooled Volkswagen engines, and we work on water-cooled VWs too.
The crew are VW people through and through. Ross Maitland works as both a mechanic and machinist, Eddie Radillo builds transmissions, and Keith Gosselin is an engine builder and mechanic. Between them you'll find a love of Baja Bugs, drag racing and off-road racing.
We're rated 4.8 from 168 Google reviews. One customer called us incredibly knowledgeable, fast and efficient, and another said we have good turn around times. You'll also find us out at local VW events like Denver Dub Fest and the Dub Roast.

## Services
- Machine shop services: Precision machine work on cases, flywheels, cranks, rods, lifters and cylinder heads for a range of VW engine types, including waterboxers.
- Engine and transmission rebuilding: Engine and transmission rebuilds for air-cooled VW owners around Denver.
- General repair and service: Brakes, oil changes, engine and transmission removal and replacement, and a variety of other mechanical repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on air-cooled VWs?
A: No. Air-cooled Volkswagens are where we started, but we work on both air-cooled and water-cooled VWs.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays in the winter?
A: We close on Saturdays for the winter season, and regular Saturday hours resume in April. If you need help outside our regular schedule, give us a call and we'll be happy to help.

Q: I have a question about a parts order. How do I reach you?
A: Email painters@paintersgrinding.com with your name, phone number, order number and the date you bought your parts, and a customer service representative will get back to you.
